note: Public traits allowed to have zero implementors and zero generic-bound uses. Checked by `ix doctor` (see crates/ix-skill/src/doctor/orphan_traits.rs). Every entry needs a non-empty `reason`: the point of this file is that a human said whether the trait is dead surface or a contract still waiting to be honoured. Entries whose trait stops being an orphan are reported as stale and must be removed. This list is a baseline of what was already true when the check landed (ix#185) — it is not a place to park new orphans.

allow.reason: Declared contract that nothing satisfies. crates/ix-io/src/protocol.rs opens with "Every I/O backend implements DataSource and/or DataSink" while eight backends in ix-io implement neither, and no code takes it as a bound. Tracked separately; resolve by implementing it in the backends or by deleting the trait and correcting the module doc.
